mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.subtitle: Let an AI agent work in this workshop through the Model Context Protocol. It uses the same production rules, events and audit log as the app, so an agent can plan, release, start and report work without the browser.
mcp.connectionHint: Streamable HTTP, stateless: any request can reach any server instance behind a load balancer, authenticated with a bearer token per request. Fill in the values and copy the generated configuration.
mcp.endpointHint: Where the MCP server listens, for example https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Serve it behind TLS.
mcp.actorHint: Writes by the agent are logged under this profile. Create one profile per agent so the activity log stays honest.
mcp.bearerHint: Generated in your browser and stored nowhere. Put it in MCP_BEARER on the server and in the client configuration.
mcp.mcpServers: Claude Desktop, Cursor and other clients (mcpServers)
mcp.activityHint: The last actions logged under the selected profile.
mcp.activityEmpty: No activity for this profile yet.
mcp.securityService: The server needs the Supabase service-role key. Run it on infrastructure you trust and never paste that key into the app.
mcp.securityTenant: Keep TENANT_ID set so the server is pinned to this workshop.
mcp.securityHttp: Expose HTTP only behind TLS with a bearer token, and replace the token when a client is retired.
mcp.securityRules: Agents cannot bypass production rules: the database refuses an invalid transition and the tool result carries the reason.
